result.verdict:
I found 1 high-severity error (line 10, the P3 claim) and 10 low ones. None changes a pass count, tier, selection, f* or headline count. I checked everything else against the JSON files and it matches within rounding:
- Both user tables, cell by cell: QQQ, P2, P3, nearest and most-defensive under PRIM; P2, P3, nearest and most-defensive under RAW. The PRIM rows match df7_final report.PRIM, not the step-A HALF rows, as intended.
- v1 and v2 rows against RESULT_DF6_KO.md lines 20-40.
- 198 rules split 76/110/12; per-gate passes F1 G1 3, F2 45/27/25/1/1, F3 0; 0 passers, tier 1 = tier 2 = 0.
- Both 4/5 rules (−0.11%p, 7.5%, −0.48%p; 7 neighbours each, 0 passing) and the family bests with their gate counts.
- f*: 0.70 for the nearest rule, 0.80 for P2, 0.95 for the most-defensive pick; F1 and F3 never pass up to 1.0.
- Post-hoc passes 0/1/8/14/21/30/30, all F2, with F1 and F3 at 0; the 70% and 80% picks and their REAL values.
- F3 REAL values: 4.9/−90 and 11.9/−78.
- Trend stats: 10.1%, 13.0%, Sharpe 0.78 / 0.997 / 0.606.
- All the verifier numbers quoted in the draft.

The one material problem is line 10's description of P3. P3 passes only G3. Its drawdown margins are REAL 7.8%, P30 9.4%, X30 2.6% and X10 1.5%, not just a 9% P30 shortfall. Its REAL return edge is +1.1%p, outside the stated +0.1 to +0.7.

Scripts are in /tmp/df7c_numbers (chk.py, chk2.py, chk3.py, chk4.py). Nothing was written under /mnt/project-files.

errors.quote: P3는 주 관례에서 세 기준 모두 수익은 QQQ보다 조금 높고(+0.1~0.7%p) 낙폭도 얕지만 가상 30년 낙폭 여유 9%로 10% 기준 미달. (line 10)
errors.problem: The return part holds. Under PRIM, P3's median CAGR beats QQQ at every horizon and on REAL: P5 +0.37, P10 +0.88, P20 +0.17, P30 +0.67, X5 +0.74, X10 +0.91, X20 +0.70, X30 +0.13, REAL +1.12. But '+0.1~0.7' is the paired-median range with REAL left out; the median gaps shown in the table reach +0.9 and +1.1. The drawdown part frames P3 as a near miss, and the files contradict that. P3's p10 MDD margins are REAL 7.8%, P30 9.4%, P10 10.5%, X30 2.6%, X10 1.5% (X5 8.2%, X20 2.6%). P3 therefore fails the 10% rule on 4 of 5 gate keys (G1, G2, G4, G5) and passes only G3. In the crash-free world its tail drawdown is essentially QQQ's: X10 -32.8 vs -33.3, X30 -37.3 vs -38.3. Its median MDD is deeper than QQQ at X5 (-22.8 vs -21.4) and X10 (-27.3 vs -25.4). Even under RAW, the optimistic upper bound, the X10/X20/X30 margins are only 5.4/5.6/6.8%, so P3 fails at every trend level tested. The first table itself shows X10 -33 vs -33, which contradicts this sentence. Pass counts, tiers, selection and f* do not change, but the headline statement about the user's portfolio does.
errors.correct_value: P3는 주 관례에서 모든 기간과 실제 경로에서 수익이 QQQ보다 높다(중앙값 +0.1~1.1%p, 짝 비교 +0.1~0.7%p, 실제 +1.1%p). 그러나 낙폭 여유는 실제 7.8%, 가상 30년 9.4%, 극악 제외 10년 1.5%, 극악 제외 30년 2.6%로 5개 관문 중 4개에서 10% 기준에 못 미친다. 극악 제외 세계의 하위 10% 낙폭은 사실상 QQQ와 같다. 추세 100% + 원자료(RAW)에서도 극악 제외 낙폭 여유가 5~7%라 기준에 못 미친다.

- **(a) Post-hoc presented as a selection:** none. Every post-hoc item carries a label, except the RAW-table 최방어 row (line 31), which has none.
- **(b) 최방어 row:** fails. The name implies the most defensive rule, but under PRIM 54 of 198 pre-registered rules have a larger minimum drawdown margin, and it trails QQQ on return everywhere except REAL. It is a post-hoc pick at trend 100%/RAW with f* 0.95. Its label and condition need fixing (high).
- **(c) P3:** the return claim is true at every horizon and on REAL. The drawdown framing is materially misleading (high): P3 fails the 10% margin on 4 of 5 gate keys. Its X10/X30 margins are only 1.5%/2.6%, and it still fails at RAW.
- **(d) Why results were tied to QQQ:** partly supported. 'No managed-futures axis' holds, but DF1~DF6 did have Nasdaq and per-asset trend rules. Zero gold/bond excess applies to DF5/DF6 only. The post-hoc RAW run shows F1 still fails, and its best member holds no gold or bonds even with raw gold/bond returns. So the binding constraint is the crash-free-world QQQ hurdle (20.5~21.8%), not just the zero-excess assumption.
- **(e) Trend calibration:** matches the proxy verifier: PRIM fair to mildly optimistic, 25% a reasonable pessimistic case, 70~80% optimistic.
- **(f) Reader of the conclusion and first table only:** misled by the P3 sentence, the 최방어 row, '전부 QLD+RSST+GDE+DBMF(사용자 방식)' (several passers hold no DBMF), and the 'verified, difference 0' claim. That claim does not cover the post-hoc scan or picks, which were run after the verifiers.
- **(g) Arithmetic means across paths:** none used for judgement. The only pooled mean is the pre-registered calibration shift (TR[sel].mean() in panel7).
